source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q46970 ; wdt:P17 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P576 ?end } FILTER(?sitelinks > 25) } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 400 } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?n = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 264

country.match: Match each airline to the country it is based in.
country.odd: Three of these airlines are based in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: flydubai
rows.description: Emirati government-owned low-cost airline based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
rows.hook: is a budget carrier that connects a glitzy desert hub to dozens of cities across the Middle East and beyond

rows.label: American Airlines
rows.description: major airline of the United States
rows.hook: is the world's biggest carrier by fleet size, with a major hub in Dallas and Charlotte

rows.label: Delta Air Lines
rows.hook: is a giant carrier headquartered in Atlanta, home to the world's busiest passenger hub

rows.label: IndiGo
rows.hook: is the biggest carrier in its home market, easily spotted by its blue-and-white planes

rows.label: Ryanair
rows.hook: is Europe's busiest budget carrier, known for bare-bones fares and strict baggage fees

rows.label: Etihad Airways
rows.description: flag-carrier airline of the United Arab Emirates
rows.hook: is a Gulf flag carrier based in Abu Dhabi, known for luxury flying suites with a private shower

rows.label: Lufthansa
rows.description: Flag-carrier and largest airline of Germany
rows.hook: is a flag carrier whose yellow-and-blue crane logo is among Europe's best known, with its hub in Frankfurt

rows.label: British Airways
rows.description: flag carrier airline of the United Kingdom
rows.hook: is a flag carrier based at London Heathrow that once flew the supersonic Concorde

rows.label: Southwest Airlines
rows.hook: is a budget carrier famous for flying only Boeing 737s, with no assigned seats and free checked bags

rows.label: Wizz Air
rows.hook: is a purple-and-pink budget carrier that spreads cheap fares across Central and Eastern Europe

rows.label: Qantas Airways
rows.description: the flag carrier airline of Australia
rows.hook: is a flag carrier known for a flying kangaroo logo and some of the longest nonstop flights in the world

rows.label: Alaska Airlines
rows.hook: is a West Coast carrier with a smiling Inuit man on its tails, based in Seattle

rows.label: easyJet
rows.hook: is a budget carrier whose bright orange planes buzz around Europe's short-haul routes

rows.label: KLM
rows.description: flag carrier airline of the Netherlands
rows.hook: is the oldest carrier in the world still flying under its original name, with a hub at Amsterdam Schiphol

rows.label: Virgin Atlantic
rows.hook: is a flamboyant long-haul carrier with red planes and a flying-lady logo, started by a daring billionaire

rows.label: All Nippon Airways
rows.hook: is one of the biggest carriers in its country, known for its blue livery and sea-turtle painted jets

rows.label: JetBlue Airways
rows.hook: is a New York based low-fare carrier famous for free snacks and live TV at every seat

rows.label: Frontier Airlines
rows.hook: is an ultra-low-cost carrier with a different animal painted on each plane's tail

rows.label: Aer Lingus
rows.hook: is a flag carrier with a green shamrock on its tail that connects Dublin to North America

rows.label: ITA Airways
rows.hook: is a flag carrier founded as the successor of a famously troubled national airline, with its hub in Rome

rows.label: AirAsia
rows.hook: is a red-liveried budget giant whose slogan says now everyone can fly

rows.label: Condor Flugdienst
rows.hook: is a leisure carrier that flies vacationers to sunny holiday beaches on yellow-tailed planes

rows.label: Asiana Airlines
rows.hook: is a flag carrier with a hub at Incheon, long a rival of its larger national competitor

rows.label: Allegiant Air
rows.description: United States based low cost airline
rows.hook: is an ultra-low-cost carrier that mostly flies leisure travelers from smaller cities to Las Vegas and Florida

rows.label: Ethiopian Airlines
rows.hook: is Africa's largest carrier by passengers and a hub for flights across the continent from Addis Ababa

rows.label: WestJet
rows.hook: is a carrier with a cheerful teal livery, based in Calgary

rows.label: AirBaltic
rows.description: Latvian airline; flag-carrier airline of Latvia
rows.hook: is a Baltic carrier based in Riga that flies Airbus A220 jets

rows.label: Iberia
rows.hook: is a flag carrier with a hub in Madrid, long the main link between Europe and Latin America

rows.label: Gulf Air
rows.hook: is a small flag carrier based in Manama, named for the waters its home island kingdom sits in

rows.label: Hawaiian Airlines
rows.description: airline in the western United States
rows.hook: is a carrier with a Polynesian woman painted on its tail, connecting the islands to the mainland

rows.label: SpiceJet
rows.hook: is a red-and-yellow budget carrier that has struggled with debts and grounded jets

rows.label: Air Arabia
rows.description: Emirati low-cost airline based in Sharjah, UAE
rows.hook: is a pioneering budget carrier from the Gulf, flying out of a hub at Sharjah

rows.label: Pegasus Airlines
rows.description: Turkish low-cost airline headquartered in Pendik, Istanbul
rows.hook: is a budget carrier whose red-and-white planes link Istanbul's second airport to Europe and Asia

rows.label: Aegean Airlines
rows.hook: is a flag carrier that serves many sun-soaked holiday islands in the Mediterranean from Athens

rows.label: Jet2.com
rows.hook: is a budget carrier with a cheeky slogan, a big seller of package holidays from northern airports

rows.label: Scoot
rows.description: Singaporean low-cost airline and a wholly owned subsidiary of Singapore Airlines
rows.hook: is the budget arm of a famous long-haul carrier, with a yellow livery that is easy to spot

rows.label: Cebu Pacific
rows.hook: is a budget carrier that links an archipelago's many islands and popularized cheap promo seat sales

rows.label: Air Transat
rows.hook: is a holiday carrier that flies sun seekers from cold Montreal and Toronto to Caribbean beaches

rows.label: Avianca
rows.hook: is one of the oldest carriers in the Americas, with a hub in Bogota

rows.label: LATAM Airlines
rows.hook: is South America's largest carrier, formed by merging a flag carrier with a Brazilian rival

rows.label: Jetstar Airways
rows.hook: is the budget arm of a flag carrier, with an orange star logo, covering Asia and the Pacific

rows.label: Vueling
rows.hook: is a Barcelona based budget carrier with a bright yellow livery

rows.label: Transavia
rows.hook: is a budget carrier that flies sun seekers to Mediterranean resorts, owned by a famous flag carrier

rows.label: Brussels Airlines
rows.hook: is a carrier based at the airport of Europe's capital, part of a big European group, flying mainly to Africa

rows.label: Eurowings
rows.description: German low-cost airline; part of Lufthansa Group
rows.hook: is the low-cost arm of a major flag carrier, known for short-haul flights across Europe

rows.label: Air Europa
rows.hook: is a Madrid based carrier that competes with the biggest national airline in transatlantic routes

rows.label: VietJet Air
rows.hook: is a budget carrier known for its bright red planes and bikini-clad flight attendants in promotions

rows.label: TUI Airways
rows.description: Charter airline based in the United Kingdom
rows.hook: is a charter carrier that flies package holidaymakers to Mediterranean resorts, run by a big tour operator

rows.label: Copa Airlines
rows.hook: is a flag carrier with a hub in a canal-crossing capital, known as the Hub of the Americas

rows.label: Volaris
rows.hook: is a budget carrier that carries travelers across a big North American country and into the United States
